prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static String quotaLedger(String input)
Behavior: Parse limit;account:delta records. Limit is a canonical unsigned decimal in 0..10000000; accounts use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*; deltas are canonical signed decimals in -10000000..10000000. Apply in order from zero and reject any balance below zero or above limit. Return all touched account balances sorted by account.
Visible example: 10;a:4,b:3,a:-1 returns a=3,b=3.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String quotaLedger(String s){try{String[]p=s.split(";",-1);if(p.length!=2||p[1].isEmpty()||!p[0].matches("0|[1-9][0-9]*"))return null;long limit=Long.parseLong(p[0]);if(limit>10000000)return null;var d=new TreeMap<String,Long>();for(String r:p[1].split(",",-1)){String[]q=r.split(":",-1);if(q.length!=2||!q[0].matches("[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*")||!q[1].matches("0|-?[1-9][0-9]*"))return null;long x=Long.parseLong(q[1]);if(x < -10000000||x>10000000)return null;long v=Math.addExact(d.getOrDefault(q[0],0L),x);if(v<0||v>limit)return null;d.put(q[0],v);}return d.entrySet().stream().map(e->e.getKey()+"="+e.getValue()).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.joining(","));}catch(Exception e){return null;}}}
